questions.stem_text: Which of the following is not among the methods unions use to increase wages?

options.A: Seeking to increase the demand for the union's labor
options.B: Negotiations to obtain a wage floor
options.C: Encouraging workers to increase their productivity
options.D: Lobbying for higher minimum wage laws

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Seeking to increase the demand for the union's labor

questions.stem_text: Which of the following is a consequence of a protective tariff on imported steel?

options.C: It results in a decrease in domestic steel production.
options.D: Income is transferred from domestic steel consumers to domestic steel producers.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Income is transferred from domestic steel consumers to domestic steel producers.

questions.stem_text:
Theo loses his job at the public swimming pool when the pool closes for the winter. This
is an example of

options.A: changes in the money supply have significant effects.
options.B: fiscal policy should not be used to manage the economy.
options.C: the FED should allow the money supply to grow at a constant rate.
options.D: fiscal policy has no impact on the economy.
options.E: the FED should decrease the money supply to combat inflation.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - changes in the money supply have significant effects.

questions.stem_text: Under a pure capitalist system, would the government play a majorrole in the economy?

options.A: Government intervenes only during economic crises to stabilize the market
options.B: Government plays a minor role by enforcing contracts and property rights
options.C: No government intervention in the economy
options.D: Government provides public goods and services but does not control private enterprise
options.E: Limited government intervention primarily in defense and public safety

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - No government intervention in the economy
